AppPush.Title: [EN] [DANGER] IMMEDIATELY DISABLE MOBILE MODE IN GENSHIN AND HSR!
AppPush.Message:
Hi Collapse users!
HoYoverse has made it a bannable offense in GI (Co-op ban) to use Mobile Mode feature, so please DISABLE it immediately. We will work push an update to disable this feature in-code but so long you are seeing this message, DISABLE IT BEFORE OPENING THE GAME!

RegionPush.Title: [EN] Google Play Region now requires running Google Play Games
RegionPush.Message:
Hi Travelers!
HoYoVerse has done some changes to how Google Play region is launched. You now have to run Google Play runtime before launching the game or the game wont run.
As of now, no workaround is available other than launching the GPlay runtime/launcher. You can start the GPlay runtime by adding the executable to the 'Pre-launch Commands' you can find under 'Game Settings'->'Advanced Settings'
Let us know if you need help on setting them up either in Discord or in GitHub issue!
